title: India news: Protesters march to Election Commission demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
summary: A coalition of students, farmers and civil society groups have joined calls for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over India's voter roll revision exercise. DW has more.

image.caption: According to media reports, the police detained some of the protesters who were marching to the ECI officeImage: Manish Swarup/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: The Swadeshi Jagran Manch (SJM), an organization affiliated with India's Hindu nationalist Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) movement marched against SpaceX founder Elon Musk's Starlink in New Delhi on Friday,
They said Starlink poses national security and digital sovereignty concerns. Read more here
